scope: Current-evidence group/private initiatives, quiet hours and durable budgets, evidence-based outcomes, bounded arbitration and direct-response priority

findings_fixed: Privacy erasure of an uncited included source during assessment/composition now invalidates the frozen frame.
Private terminal outcome evidence cannot be erased by later neutral same-topic notes or a bounded recent-window rollover.
Reply-scoped refusal and resolution no longer hard-veto unrelated questions sharing lexical words.
Older decisive anchor evidence survives the public question/window caps; partial success and later owner correction remain assessable.
Opt-out, stop, timezone, topic closure and feedback/reaction changes are serialized or revision-fenced against final send.
Complete hidden outcome source lineage is retained internally; over-cap snippets are omitted whole.
Unchanged explicit reminder paraphrases retain verified exact request authorization; new schedules cannot borrow old consent.
Only authoritative delivered outbox receipts mark goal/workflow sends delivered; invalidated and ambiguous outcomes cannot complete a new revision.

synthetic_load.cost_measurement: Offline recorded judge; actual provider latency and cost are not measured.

validation_environment.database: Disposable PostgreSQL 17, isolated per SQL case
validation_environment.network: Offline test guard allows only loopback

limitations: Synthetic recorded interpretations and mocked responses test deterministic contracts, not live semantic judgement, naturalness or social usefulness.
Optional-work timeout budgets can be extended by separately bounded owned cleanup; already-started provider/Telegram requests cannot be recalled retroactively.
Direct replies preempt speculative pretransport leases; an already-started or direct transport may cause bounded safe suppression rather than guaranteed immediate delivery.
Private relevance uses existing structured interpretations and a bounded recent window, plus all-newer terminal-outcome barriers; missing evidence causes conservative abstention.
A description-only same-key goal rewrite does not renew its delivered slot. Distinct semantic goals still depend on correct extracted stable keys.
Already-neutral pre-upgrade reminders without saved request lineage remain blocked unless the current source itself provides exact valid reminder authorization.
Arti own commitments are not executed by this scheduler; no arbitrary executor or all-history planning engine is added.
Thresholds and quotas are engineering defaults, not learned psychological measurements or consent from silence.

The existing coordinator has no new global fair queue; heavily active contexts can lose optional opportunities. Load latency measures synthetic local ingestion, not provider latency or production performance.
No production API calls, live user history, deployment, merge or end-to-end live LLM behavior evaluation.
